rule: Kept: every language gives a full date, none hedged, no old-style calendar in the lead, gap not the Julian offset, not thrown out by the manual read. Score: 3 if two languages agree against the third, 2 if read by hand, 1 if Finnish once agreed with the other value. Ties by size of the gap.
